jp:
<STBG 3,1><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,1,5,0,3><CV 3,36>Eliza, may I have a word?
Do you know of Yoga?
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,0,2><CV 1,89>Yoga...?

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,0>Yes, Yoga is, you see,
an art and practice handed down
since ancient times.

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,8><CV 3,18>So I'd like you, Eliza,
to master Yoga by all means.
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,2,3><CV 1,4>Yes!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,0><CV 3,22>With Yoga,
I want you to stretch your arms.
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,7>…

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,0>With Yoga,
I want you to breathe fire.

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,1><CV 3,5>With Yoga,
I want you to... float!
You!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,0><CV 3,27>Eliza, in fact, when I looked into you,
I found you had the gift to grasp
Yoga's essence, 'Harmony'...

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,8><CV 3,5>So I want you
to train in Yoga.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,7><CV 1,24>No no no...
Look, I'm busy exploring...

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,4><CV 3,22>It's fine.
Did you know that 'Yoga Species'
have been appearing lately?

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,0><CV 3,27>Slay them,
and you seem able to grasp
the very essence of Yoga.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,5><CV 1,94>That's impossible!
Besides, I'm not even flexible...

<BGM 1,0,505><BGM 0,0,508><TALK 5><NAME 14><CHAR 5,5,12,0,0><CV 17,4>That's right, Eliza.
With your current body it's unreasonable.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,2,8><CV 1,26>Solphine!
So it IS impossible!

<TALK 5><NAME 14><CHAR 5,0,12,0,0><CV 17,12>Yes... so first,
let's try removing a joint.

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,8><CV 3,29>To know that...
have you too practiced Yoga...?

<TALK 1><NAME 14><CHAR 1,0,12,0,0><CV 17,21>Yes, I aimed for it...
thinking it might guard Lady Yuno...

<TALK 1><NAME 14><CHAR 1,0,12,0,7>But Yoga's essence, Harmony...
I never came to understand what it is,
and in the end couldn't master it.

<TALK 1><NAME 14><CHAR 1,0,12,0,0><CV 17,19>Eliza...
if you have that gift... would you inherit
my will and master Yoga...?
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0>Oh, um...
<TALK 1><NAME 14><CHAR 1,0,12,0,0><CV 17,12>This is my wish.

<TALK 1><NAME 14><CV 17,18>If it is fulfilled,
as a master of arts and harmony,
I want to welcome you into our clan.

<TALK 1><NAME 14><CHAR 1,0,12,0,8><ITEM AD_BODY495,1,1><CV 17,19>Slay the Yoga Species,
and once you are versed in Yoga...
we shall gift you this clan-heirloom gear.

<TALK 1><NAME 14><CHAR 1,0,12,0,1>I hear it is gear imitating a legendary
martial artist. Evolving makes it stronger.

<BGM 1,0,505><BGM 0,0,507><ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,8><CV 3,29>Solphine...
so you too were bewitched by Yoga.

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,0>Eliza... inherit our will,
and master the path of Yoga!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><ITEM LIMITED00086,1,1><CHAR 5,0,5,0,8>Yes, the Yoga Species came with this info:
slay one and you can get
a great ticket, apparently.
<ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,2>...a ticket?

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,8><ITEM AD_BODY2079,1,1><CV 3,13>Yes, gather those tickets and
you can surely obtain the gear of the
legendary martial artist everyone knows of.
<ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,0,5,0,3><CV 3,18>Then, I leave it to you!
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,0>Could you... remove a joint for me instead?
<CLS>
